label: proton motive force
definition: An electrochemical gradient of protons across a microbial membrane that constitutes the immediate energy source for ATP synthesis, active transport, and flagellar rotation; arises from coupled electron-transport and proton-pumping activities.
observations: microbe-bioenergetics abstraction; no clean upstream home (not a GO process per se, not a CHEBI entity)
traits_addressed: covers 16 causal-graph BIOLOGICAL_PROCESS nodes across respiration, transport, motility, and homeostasis trait graphs

label: microbial biomass
definition: The aggregate organic matter of a microbial cell or population, treated as the sink for assimilated carbon and the source of cellular structural and functional components.
observations: often (mis)typed as BIOLOGICAL_PROCESS in the corpus; semantically a material entity / assimilation sink
traits_addressed: covers 16 causal-graph nodes across heterotrophy, autotrophy, and methylotrophy trait graphs

label: inorganic electron donor
definition: A class of reduced inorganic chemical species (e.g. H2, H2S, S0, Fe(II), NH4+, NO2-, Mn(II), CO) that microorganisms oxidize to extract electrons for energy conservation or biosynthesis; the defining substrate of chemolithotrophy.
observations: class-of-chemicals abstraction; CHEBI has individual species but no superclass for "inorganic electron donor in lithotrophy" sense
traits_addressed: covers 7 causal-graph CHEMICAL nodes in lithotrophy and respiratory metabolism graphs

label: reducing power
definition: The electron-donating capacity present in a metabolic pool, typically realized as reduced cofactors such as NADH, NADPH, ferredoxin, or coenzyme F420; quantitatively a redox state, distinct from individual reducer species.
observations: often typed as CHEMICAL in the corpus though semantically a capacity / electron pool
traits_addressed: covers 4 causal-graph CHEMICAL nodes across photo- and chemolithotrophic energy-capture graphs

label: terminal electron acceptor
definition: A chemical species that accepts electrons at the end of a microbial respiratory or fermentation electron-transport chain, completing the redox circuit and enabling sustained electron flux.
observations: overlap with specific CHEBI species (O2, NO3-, SO4(2-)) but the role-of class is missing upstream
traits_addressed: covers 5 causal-graph nodes (3 CHEMICAL + 2 MOLECULAR_FUNCTION) across respiration and electron-transfer trait graphs

label: membrane fluidity
definition: The dynamic mobility of lipid molecules in a microbial membrane bilayer; modulated by temperature, fatty-acid saturation, and homeoviscous-adaptation responses.
observations: typed as BIOLOGICAL_PROCESS in the corpus though semantically a quality (PATO axis); PATO has no exact term
traits_addressed: covers 6 causal-graph BIOLOGICAL_PROCESS nodes in psychrophilic, mesophilic, and thermophilic trait graphs
